original_prompt: Create an Ansible playbook that installs the OpenTelemetry Collector (binary or yum/apt repository), configures it to receive OTLP on port 4317 and export to a remote endpoint, and starts it as a systemd service.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: Ansible playbook (YAML)

Task: Create an Ansible playbook that installs the OpenTelemetry Collector (binary or yum/apt repository), configures it to receive OTLP on port 4317 and export to a remote endpoint, and starts it as a systemd service.

Output only the Ansible playbook (YAML) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
- name: Install and configure OpenTelemetry Collector
  hosts: all
  become: yes
  vars:
    otel_collector_version: "0.102.1"
    otel_collector_arch: "amd64"
    otel_collector_platform: "linux"
    otel_collector_endpoint: "https://your-otel-backend.example.com:4317"
    otel_collector_config_dir: "/etc/otelcol"
    otel_collector_binary_path: "/usr/local/bin/otelcol"
    otel_collector_user: "otel"
    otel_collector_group: "otel"

  tasks:
    - name: Create otel system group
      group:
        name: "{{ otel_collector_group }}"
        system: yes
        state: present

    - name: Create otel system user
      user:
        name: "{{ otel_collector_user }}"
        group: "{{ otel_collector_group }}"
        system: yes
        shell: /sbin/nologin
        create_home: no
        state: present

    - name: Create configuration directory
      file:
        path: "{{ otel_collector_config_dir }}"
        state: directory
        owner: "{{ otel_collector_user }}"
        group: "{{ otel_collector_group }}"
        mode: 0750

    - name: Download OpenTelemetry Collector binary
      get_url:
        url: "https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector-releases/releases/download/v{{ otel_collector_version }}/otelcol_{{ otel_collector_version }}_{{ otel_collector_platform }}_{{ otel_collector_arch }}.tar.gz"
        dest: "/tmp/otelcol.tar.gz"
        checksum: "sha256:https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector-releases/releases/download/v{{ otel_collector_version }}/otelcol_{{ otel_collector_version }}_{{ otel_collector_platform }}_{{ otel_collector_arch }}.tar.gz.sha256sum"
        mode: 0640

    - name: Extract OpenTelemetry Collector binary
      unarchive:
        src: "/tmp/otelcol.tar.gz"
        dest: "/tmp/"
        remote_src: yes
        creates: "/tmp/otelcol"
        mode: 0755

    - name: Install OpenTelemetry Collector binary
      copy:
        src: "/tmp/otelcol"
        dest: "{{ otel_collector_binary_path }}"
        remote_src: yes
        owner: root
        group: root
        mode: 0755

    - name: Clean up temporary files
      file:
        path: "{{ item }}"
        state: absent
      loop:
        - "/tmp/otelcol.tar.gz"
        - "/tmp/otelcol"

    - name: Deploy OpenTelemetry Collector configuration
      copy:
        dest: "{{ otel_collector_config_dir }}/config.yaml"
        owner: "{{ otel_collector_user }}"
        group: "{{ otel_collector_group }}"
        mode: 0640
        content: |
          receivers:
            otlp:
              protocols:
                grpc:
                  endpoint: 0.0.0.0:4317
          exporters:
            otlp:
              endpoint: "{{ otel_collector_endpoint }}"
              tls:
                insecure: true
          service:
            pipelines:
              traces:
                receivers: [otlp]
                exporters: [otlp]
              metrics:
                receivers: [otlp]
                exporters: [otlp]
              logs:
                receivers: [otlp]
                exporters: [otlp]

    - name: Deploy systemd service unit
      copy:
        dest: /etc/systemd/system/otelcol.service
        owner: root
        group: root
        mode: 0644
        content: |
          [Unit]
          Description=OpenTelemetry Collector
          After=network.target

          [Service]
          Type=simple
          User={{ otel_collector_user }}
          Group={{ otel_collector_group }}
          ExecStart={{ otel_collector_binary_path }} --config={{ otel_collector_config_dir }}/config.yaml
          Restart=on-failure
          RestartSec=10
          LimitNOFILE=65536

          [Install]
          WantedBy=multi-user.target

    - name: Reload systemd daemon
      systemd:
        daemon_reload: yes

    - name: Enable and start OpenTelemetry Collector service
      systemd:
        name: otelcol
        enabled: yes
        state: started
